items.title: Exelon's Q2 Earnings In Line With Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y
items.summary: EXC's Q2 adjusted earnings rise 10.3% as higher utility rates lifted results, while revenues climb 10% and beat estimates.

items.title: WEC Q2 Earnings Surpass on Rate Base Growth, Revenues Rise Y/Y
items.summary: WEC Energy's Q2 earnings beat estimates as rate base growth and infrastructure gains lift profit, while revenues rise and its $37.5B plan advances.

items.title: Duke Energy to Release Q2 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
items.summary: DUK heads into Q2 earnings with expectations of EPS growth, backed by grid investments, rising power demand and recent infrastructure milestones.

items.title: NorthWestern (NWE) Beats Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: NorthWestern (NWE) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +19.05% and +4.08%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: FirstEnergy Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Transmission Growth
items.summary: FE's Q2 earnings and revenues top estimates as transmission growth and rising data-center demand support investment plans.

items.title: Eversource to Report Q2 Earnings: What to Expect From the Stock?
items.summary: Es' Q2 results may have reflected grid investments, rate increases and demand growth, while higher interest, taxes and dilution pose risks.

items.title: A $1.2 Million Portfolio That Pays $7,000 a Month and Stays Below the IRMAA Surcharge Line
items.summary: Generating $7,000 a month in retirement sounds like a math problem, but for Medicare-eligible investors it's also a tax trap where chasing a higher yield can quietly trigger surcharges that claw back the gains.

items.title: CenterPoint Energy Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Improve Y/Y
items.summary: CNP's Q2 adjusted earnings beat estimates as revenues rise 10.7% year over year and operating income climbs to $534 million.
